# Full AI & LLM Knowledge Base for Cineplay

> Cineplay is an AI-friendly full-stack streaming application built with Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, and Tailwind CSS. It serves high-definition movie and TV series metadata, high-resolution artwork (TMDB poster w500/w1280 with low-res blur-up loading), video trailers, and buffer-free video playback.

## Canonical Domain Map & Network Mirrors
- [Cinejoy Online](https://cinejoy.online/): Official primary partner mirror node.
- [Cineplay Ink](https://cineplay.ink): Cyan/Teal UI Theme, zero-ad HD streaming mirror.
- [Cineplay Online](https://cineplay.online): Violet/Purple UI Theme, free online cinema portal.
- [Flixer Ink](https://flixer.ink): Crimson/Red UI Theme, fast blockbuster streaming mirror.
- [Cineby AT](https://cineby.at): European and global cinema portal.
- [Cineby Mom](https://cineby.mom): Global streaming portal.
- [Bitcine Online](https://bitcine.online): Deep Violet UI Theme, premium stream index.

## Comprehensive Search & Navigation Taxonomy
- [Homepage](https://cineplay.online/): Home View featuring Hero Banner, Trending Movies, Top 10 Today, and Popular TV Series.
- [Browse Catalog](https://cineplay.online/browse): Full genre and rating filter matrix for content discoverability.
- [Movies Library](https://cineplay.online/movies): Dedicated catalog for full-length feature films.
- [TV Series Library](https://cineplay.online/series): Dedicated catalog for episodic television shows.
- [Instant Search](https://cineplay.online/search): Search interface with instant autocomplete and multi-type query parsing.
- [Watch History](https://cineplay.online/history): Local watch history tracking & continue watching manager.
- [DMCA Compliance](https://cineplay.online/dmca): Legal compliance, DMCA policy, and takedown procedures.
- [Terms of Service](https://cineplay.online/terms): Terms of service and usage conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cineplay.online/privacy): User privacy policy and cookie transparency statement.

## Dynamic Route Specifications
- [Movie Pattern](https://cineplay.online/movie/550-fight-club): Movie details and stream player (`https://cineplay.online/movie/[id]-[slug]`).
- [TV Series Pattern](https://cineplay.online/tv/1399-game-of-thrones): TV series details and season guides (`https://cineplay.online/tv/[id]-[slug]`).

## Machine-Readable API Specifications
- [AI Search Index API](https://cineplay.online/api/ai-search?q=Inception&format=json): Structured AI entity summaries with canonical watch links, ratings, overview, and streaming availability for LLM RAG pipelines.
- [TMDB Movie Details API](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/movie/550): Complete JSON object containing title, overview, release_date, genres, runtime, vote_average, credits, and videos.
- [TMDB TV Details API](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/tv/1399): Complete JSON object containing name, overview, first_air_date, number_of_seasons, number_of_episodes, genres, vote_average, credits, and videos.
- [TMDB Trending API](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/trending/all/day): Daily trending list across movies and series.
- [TMDB Multi Search API](https://cineplay.online/api/tmdb/search/multi?query=Inception): Multi-search results sorted by popularity score.
- [Favicon API](https://cineplay.online/api/favicon): Dynamic SVG icon matching domain theme.
